records.title: Metacognition and self-regulation
records.limitations: Toolkit average impact is a synthesis, not a guaranteed individual outcome; context and implementation matter.

records.title: A Meta-Analysis of the Effectiveness and Boundary Conditions of Retrieval Practice, Distributed Practice, and Interleaved Practice in Authentic School Classrooms
supports: retrieval, spacing and interleaving in authentic classrooms
records.limitations: 53 studies, 7,303 participants; moderators and sparse cells limit universal prescriptions; use strategy according to task and learner.

records.title: Cognitive-Load Theory: Methods to Manage Working Memory Load in the Learning of Complex Tasks
records.publisher: Current Directions in Psychological Science / SAGE
records.limitations: Theory-guided instructional design; specific effects depend on task complexity, prior knowledge and implementation.

records.title: Teacher Feedback to Improve Pupil Learning
supports: alignment to learning intentions and gaps
records.limitations: Teacher/school context; adapt carefully to independent learning and automated feedback.

records.title: Calibration and Self-Regulated Learning
records.publisher: Cambridge University Press, Cambridge Handbook of Cognition and Education
records.limitations: Chapter summary and handbook context; do not infer that one confidence rating is a stable trait.

records.title: A Review of Self-regulated Learning: Six Models and Four Directions for Research
records.limitations: Multiple models differ in terminology and emphasis; ATHENA uses a practical synthesis, not a claim that models are identical.

records.title: A Meta-Analysis of Ten Learning Techniques
supports: distributed practice and practice testing among strongly supported techniques
records.limitations: Aggregated effects across heterogeneous studies; strategy effectiveness depends on outcomes and conditions.

records.title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for Pediatric Populations: A Consensus Statement of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine
records.publisher: Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine / AASM
supports: sleep associations with attention, learning and health
records.limitations: Population recommendation, not diagnosis or personalised treatment; sleep concerns belong with guardians and qualified clinicians.

records.title: High contextual interference improves retention in motor learning: systematic review and meta-analysis
supports: practice schedule variability and retention in motor learning
records.limitations: Do not generalise directly to all sports, all skill levels or unsafe high-variability practice.

records.title: The effects of self-monitoring on strategy use and academic performance: A meta-analysis
records.publisher: International Journal of Educational Research / Elsevier
supports: self-monitoring strategy use and academic performance
records.limitations: 36 experimental studies; effects depend on supports and intervention design.
